```yaml
name: Test CI

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      platform:
        description: 'Target platform'
        required: true
        default: 'ubuntu-latest'
        type: choice
        options:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - macos-14
          - windows-latest

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

jobs:
  test-platform:
    name: Test Platform (${{ github.event.inputs.platform }})
    runs-on: ${{ github.event.inputs.platform }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Setup sccache
        uses: mozilla-actions/sccache-action@v0.0.9

      - name: Configure sccache environment
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "SCCACHE_GHA_ENABLED=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "CMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=sccache" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=sccache" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Cache Rust dependencies
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          prefix-key: "v1-rust"
          shared-key: "test-ci-${{ github.event.inputs.platform }}"
          cache-all-crates: "true"
          save-if: "true"

      - name: Install LLVM (Linux)
        if: github.event.inputs.platform == 'ubuntu-latest'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y llvm-dev libclang-dev clang

      - name: Install LLVM (macOS)
        if: github.event.inputs.platform == 'macos-14'
        run: brew install llvm

      - name: Install NASM (Windows)
        if: github.event.inputs.platform == 'windows-latest'
        run: choco install nasm

      - name: Check format
        run: cargo fmt --all --check

      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Check
        run: cargo check --workspace

      - name: Test
        run: cargo test --workspace

      - name: Build release
        run: cargo build --workspace --release

      - name: Run xtask tests
        run: cargo xtask test

      - name: Run integration tests (if applicable)
        if: github.event.inputs.platform == 'ubuntu-latest'
        run: cargo test --workspace --ignored
```
